description_en: Retrieves a list of workflow instances by using paging. You can also perform a filtered query based on conditions
description_zh: 分页获取工作流实例列表，也可以通过条件进行筛选查询
name: ListWorkflowInstances

parameters.help_en: The business date. Typically, this is 00:00:00 on the day before the scheduled time of the periodic instance, formatted as a millisecond timestamp, such as 1743350400000
parameters.help_zh: 业务日期。一般是周期实例定时时间的前一天的0点0分0秒，格式为毫秒级时间戳，如1743350400000
parameters.name: biz_date

parameters.help_en:
The type of the workflow instance. Valid values:
Normal: Periodic scheduling.
Manual: Manual task.
SmokeTest: Smoke test.
SupplementData: Data backfill.
ManualWorkflow: Manual workflow.
TriggerWorkflow: Triggered workflow
parameters.help_zh:
工作流实例的类型。
Normal：周期调度
Manual：手动任务
SmokeTest：测试
SupplementData：补数据
ManualWorkflow：手动工作流
TriggerWorkflow：触发式工作流
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workflow to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: workflow_id

parameters.help_en: The unified workflow instance ID. The value of this field is the same for all workflow instances within a specific business date under a single trigger
parameters.help_zh: 统一工作流实例Id，某次触发下某业务日期内的所有工作流实例的该字段值相等
parameters.name: unified_workflow_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The list of workflow instance IDs. You can use this parameter to query multiple workflow instances in batches by their IDs
parameters.help_zh: 工作流实例ID列表，可根据工作流实例Id批量查询多个工作流实例信息
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en:
The list of sort fields. Fields such as the scheduled time and start time are supported. The format is "Sort field + Sort order (Desc/Asc)", where Asc can be omitted. Valid values for sort fields:
TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)
StartedTime (Desc/Asc)
FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)
CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
Id (Desc/Asc)

Default value: Id Desc
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段列表，支持定时时间、开始时间等字段。格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：
TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)
StartedTime (Desc/Asc)
FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)
CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
Id (Desc/Asc)

默认值：Id Desc
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. If an instance matches any of the specified tags, it is returned in the result
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，多个标签中满足一个即会返回结果
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The filter. The value is in JSON format. Multiple filter conditions are connected by the logical AND operator. Supported fields: `status` and `executionDate`
parameters.help_zh: 过滤器。JSON格式，多个过滤条件之间是"且"的关系。目前支持的字段有：`status, executionDate`
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The project environment. Valid values:
Prod: Production.
Dev: Development
parameters.help_zh:
项目环境。
Prod：生产
Dev：开发
parameters.name: env_type

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

BizDate.description_en:
The business date.

The value is a 13-digit number, such as `1710239005403`

CreateTime.description_en:
The creation time.

The value is a 13-digit number, such as `1710239005403`

CreateUser.description_en: The account ID of the user who created the workflow instance

EnvType.description_en:
The project environment. Valid values:
Prod (Production)
Dev (Development)
EnvType.description_zh:
项目环境。
Prod(生产)
Dev(开发)

FinishedTime.description_en:
The completion time.

The value is a 13-digit number, such as `1710239005403`

Id.description_en: The unique identifier of the workflow instance
Id.description_zh: 工作流实例的唯一标识符

ModifyTime.description_en:
The update time.

The value is a 13-digit number, such as `1710239005403`

ModifyUser.description_en: The account ID of the user who updated the workflow instance

Owner.description_en: The account ID of the workflow owner
Owner.description_zh: 工作流的责任人的账号ID

StartedTime.description_en:
The start time.

The value is a 13-digit number, such as `1710239005403`
StartedTime.description_zh:
开始运行时间。

格式为 13 位数字，例如 `1710239005403`

Status.description_en:
The running status of the workflow instance. Valid values:
NotRun: Not run.
Running: Running.
WaitTime: Waiting for the trigger time.
CheckingCondition: Checking branch conditions.
WaitResource: Waiting for resources.
Failure: Failed.
Success: Successful.
Checking: Submitted for data quality check
Status.description_zh:
工作流实例运行状态。
NotRun：未运行
Running：运行中
WaitTime：等待TriggerTime到来
CheckingCondition：分支条件检验
WaitResource：等待资源
Failure：执行失败
Success：执行成功
Checking：下发给数据质量校检
